question:
**Fill in the blank with the most appropriate phrasal verb:**

When the scandal broke, the minister tried to _______ responsibility and blame his aides.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. pass the buck**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"pass the buck"** means to shift responsibility or blame for something to someone else instead of taking it yourself. (जिम्मेदारी टालना)
 
 
• **Example:** The manager tried to pass the buck to his subordinates when the project failed.
 
 
• In the given sentence, the minister is attempting to avoid accountability and is blaming others for the scandal, which aligns with the meaning of "pass the buck." (जिम्मेदारी दूसरों पर डालना)
